tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.class: Student Assessment- Tests or Project-Based Activities
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Achebe
professor.text: We've been discussing different approaches to student assessment. Traditional exams and standardized tests are commonly used to objectively measure student performance. Some educators, however, advocate for alternative measurements of aptitude other than tests, such as project-based activities and class participation, because tests are limited in their ability to assess learning. What do you think is the most effective way to assess student learning? Why?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: I believe project-based activities are the most effective way to measure student learning. They allow students to apply their knowledge in real-world contexts and demonstrate their skills through practical tasks. This approach encourages deeper understanding and creativity.

posts.name: Paul
posts.text: In my opinion, traditional exams and standardized tests are still the best way to assess student performance. They provide a consistent and objective measure of what students have learned and allow for easy comparison across different groups of students.
